title: FR: Watch alert for leaving phone Bluetooth range
symptom: The user requests an option for a missed readings alert on the watch that would go off even when the phone is turned off or not in communication with the watch, useful for times when the phone battery dies or the phone is left elsewhere.
evidence_quote: Could there be an option to have a missed readings alert that will go off on the watch even when the phone is turned off or not in communication with the watch?
